items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（16 行证明）、相对循环等维性的 fppf 下降：正向一句引理；反向万有开性 → 支撑引理 → f_i^{-1}(W) 即拉回支撑闭包 → 相对维数 ≤ r → 纤维维数引理＋联合满回传。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-equidimensional-fppf-descent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1600-1607

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The forward direction is functoriality of equidimensionality. For the converse, the members of the fppf covering are universally open, so the base-changed morphism f_i is open and the support of the pulled back cycle is the inverse image of the support; hence the closure of the pulled back support is the inverse image of the closure W, has relative dimension at most r over S_i by assumption, and the cited dimension-of-fibres lemma together with joint surjectivity of the covering gives relative dimension at most r for W over S (source lines 1609-1624)
